required_attestation_limits.base: The receipt records an observation of a native C2PA validation performed by a named external validator over pinned inputs. It does not establish content truth, depicted-event truth, physical liveness, universal signer trust, independent ARCS recomputation, DAGR admission, or public standing.

notes: PROVISIONAL: this profile is not stable and has not been ratified. C2PA remains the native authority for every C2PA finding recorded here.
External-binding relation mode is validation_observation (governing doctrine s10). This receipt observes a native validation; it is not native emission and it is not an independent recomputation.
No envelope field is added and no frozen envelope bytes are changed. All profile fields are profile-owned placements.
A process exit code is never a validation verdict; verdict_source is fixed to native_machine_report.
native_validation_state is a native field only. It is never an SRS verdict and never a signer-trust statement; native failures are preserved independently in native_findings.
Native result, signer trust, signer validity, and trusted timestamp are independent axes. No aggregate roll-up field may appear.
Trust material is digest-bound bytes. A trust-list name or URL is not trust material, and remote trust pointers are never dereferenced during hermetic verification.

Validation time is not caller-injectable in the validator this profile was grounded against; replay of time-dependent trust and certificate findings is NOT claimed to be deterministic across wall-clock time.
Revocation is not_evaluated under hermetic settings. Silence about revocation is not evidence of non-revocation.
assertion_attribution gathered and redacted branches are structurally supported and empirically unexercised; no fixture manufactures coverage for them.

CANDIDATE PIN — UNRESOLVED: the generic provenance-envelope machine contract (arcs-standard, lane ARCS-PROV-ENVELOPE0, superseding the withdrawn ARCS-PROV-SIGNAL0 lane) has not landed on arcs-standard main at base 7b8985712dbf750c90cd746b8bf439f17eb25277. The generic object carries no required signal_result and references native findings opaquely. No digest exists to pin. It MUST be repinned before merge readiness.
CANDIDATE PIN — DRAFT UPSTREAM: the arcs-standard EvidenceSourceDescriptor shape is DRAFT / pre-adoption and is consumed as a compatibility constraint only, never cited as stable published authority.

The profile-specific conformance decisions are held as data in conformance-rules.json and consumed by the shared checker. That file is pinned by the binding's semantic_digest, so a checker-visible rule change cannot occur without moving the digest.

The normative Markdown document is a human-readable expression of the machine contract (field schema + profile manifest + conformance-rules.json + limitation-code contract + envelope identity + fixtures). It is not a second, independent source of normative behaviour, which is why it is excluded from the semantic digest.
The verifier recomputes receipt structure only. It does not perform C2PA validation, does not establish content truth, and does not confer admission or standing.
